Recorded from `companion/tests/acp-coding-feedback-522.test.ts` using actual AcpManager CLI start, open-local-terminal command generation, emitProgress and handleAcpWsMessage cancel/refusal producers. The synthetic Node stdin child has no worker, model or network. Only native outer-terminal openers are isolated. Session ID, workspace/executable/prompt paths are normalized; payload keys are unchanged. Timeline IDs/times are captured producer output. Regenerate with `CMSPARK_RECORD_CODING_FIXTURE` after Companion test compilation; no live credentials/configuration are used.

R3 also captures the actual offered event, concurrent CLI prompt rejection and closed-session followup/prompt/apply errors. Their `request_type` is stamped by the real handler rather than guessed by the frontend. R2 before-tag producer capture and failed reducer/browser traces are retained in the local review packet. The declared `confirmed` browser input is explicitly a lifecycle-type UI case; the current manager normally emits offered then running.

The fixture command is inert test data. Browser coverage copies it through an isolated clipboard; it never runs the command or opens an external terminal. Its test clock is aligned to the frozen actual producer expiry; a separate short-deadline case proves automatic expiry rather than silently replacing a stale fixture with a new lifetime. `receipt` is the Companion acknowledgement; the unrelated runtime `{ok:true}` receipt only means forwarding.
